webinars.title: Study in the UK — Application & Visa Guide
webinars.description: A step-by-step walkthrough of UK university applications, personal statements, student visa requirements, and the IELTS pathway. Includes a live Q&A with British Council officers.

webinars.title: Navigating Medical Admissions in Pakistan
webinars.description: Comprehensive guide to MDCAT preparation, medical college applications, merit calculation, and alternative pathways including BDS and pharmacy. Panel includes current medical students.

webinars.title: HEC Foreign Scholarships — How to Apply
webinars.description: Detailed session on HEC's MS/MPhil and PhD foreign scholarship programmes, eligibility criteria, required documents, and the application portal. Past scholars share their experiences.

webinars.title: Tech Careers Without a CS Degree
webinars.description: Industry leaders discuss alternative routes into tech — coding bootcamps, freelancing, certifications, and self-study. Covers salary expectations, portfolio building, and demand trends for 2027.

webinars.title: IELTS Masterclass — Tips from IDP Examiners
webinars.description: Live IELTS preparation session led by former examiners. Covers Listening and Reading strategies, Writing Task 1 & 2 frameworks, and Speaking Part mock demonstrations. Free practice material included.

webinars.title: Fulbright Scholarship — Info Session for Pakistani Students
webinars.host: USEFP (United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan)
webinars.description: Official information session covering the Fulbright MS/PhD and Fulbright Master's programmes, application timeline, GRE waiver policies, and selection criteria. USEFP advisors answer live questions.

webinars.title: Study in Germany — Tuition-Free Universities & DAAD Scholarships
webinars.description: Everything Pakistani students need to know about German public universities (no tuition fees), the blocked account, student visas, and DAAD scholarship opportunities. German language requirements explained.

webinars.title: Business & Finance Careers — From I.Com to Corporate Leadership
webinars.description: Joint session by IBA's Career Counselling Centre and ACCA Pakistan on business career paths: accounting, finance, marketing, and entrepreneurship. Covers IBA entry test, ACCA exemptions, and internship pipelines.

webinars.title: NUST Open House — Engineering & Computing Programmes
webinars.host: National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)
webinars.description: Virtual open house with faculty from NUST's engineering and computing schools. Session covers NET preparation, programme curricula, research opportunities, and campus life. Lab demos included.

webinars.title: Beyond Medicine — Careers in Psychology & Social Sciences
webinars.description: LUMS faculty explore psychology, sociology, economics, and humanities career paths. Session debunks the myth that 'only doctors and engineers succeed' and showcases social science alumni success stories.
